title: utv package component diagram
description: The modules of the utv package grouped by layer: the typed layer calls the JSON layer underneath for every operation, so the two can't disagree.

components.name: utv package
components.responsibility: Everything a caller imports: __init__.py re-exports both layers and lists them in __all__.

components.name: Typed layer (values.py, outcome.py, policy.py, context.py, interop.py)
components.responsibility: Immutable typed values, Outcome[T] and its helpers, typed policies, the TemporalContext that holds zone rules, and typed native interop.

components.name: JSON layer (build.py, iso.py, text.py, ops.py, zones.py, _core.py)
components.responsibility: The everyday API on plain UTV JSON dicts: builders, parse_iso / format_iso, parse_text / format_text, fields, add, compare, days_between, posix_seconds_between, contains, overlaps, and zone rules with resolve, to_zone and to_offset.

components.name: Native adapters (native.py)
components.responsibility: JSON-level conversions between UTV values and datetime's date, time, datetime and timedelta, with a caller-named Intent.

components.name: Validation (validate.py, gregorian.py)
components.responsibility: Structural validation of UTV JSON text against the bundled schema, and the proleptic Gregorian check of a civil value's date fields.

components.name: Result envelope (result.py)
components.responsibility: Result, Diagnostic and Status: the utv-result/1.0 envelope every JSON-layer function returns.

components.name: Bundled schema
components.responsibility: The copy of schema/utv-1.0.schema.json the validator reads.

components.name: datetime and zoneinfo
components.responsibility: Python's standard date/time API. A ZoneInfo reads the host's tz database; utv uses only ZoneInfo objects the caller made.

relationships.description: The 0.2 everyday API and the text form.
Every typed operation builds the value's JSON and calls the JSON-level function: ops.add, ops.compare, zones.resolve, text.format_text and the rest.
interop.from_native and to_native call the utv.native adapters.
outcome_of turns a Result into an Outcome; to_result goes back.
Every operation checks its inputs with validate_value first; _core and ops use gregorian.days_in_month and is_leap_year.
Returns Results; _core.operation turns a raised _core.Outcome into one.
Builds values with build.py and checks them with _core.civil and _core.instant_seconds.
Converts date, time, datetime and timedelta; reads offsets and folds from a caller's ZoneInfo, and never constructs one.
Returns Results with status valid, invalid or unsupported.
